If your AI keeps writing [PRICE] in your posts, it doesn't know what you sell yet. The Scrolly Business Brain gives ChatGPT and Claude one place to read your offers, prices and customers. Find it at scrollyseo.com.

Here's what changed for me: my offers, prices, who each one is for and what I'm working on all live in one central place. When I ask AI for a post, it reads that first and writes with the real details.

You still check the output. You just stop spending more time correcting AI than it would take to write the post yourself.

What does your AI get wrong most often about your business? 👇

Never get AI slop again, here's how! 👇

Do you ask AI to write something for you, only for it to come back with that slightly artificial twist? Or worse, the dreaded em dash. You know what I'm talking about 😂

As a business owner, I want everything in my marketing to meet the same standard, and that includes what AI writes. So I taught it what's acceptable: how I talk, the words I love and the phrases I'd never use.

It's a one-time setup, and it keeps learning as you go. During setup it can even look back through your past chats for things you forgot to mention.

Check out scrollyseo.com to copy my homework and build your own Scrolly Business Brain.
